world_seed_model: all initial NPC stacks, treasury and merchant wallet are funded from named accounts at world initialization; do not clone or reset NPC wallets

nodes.label: The Ash Table
nodes.success: player stack >= 1 AND player tied-or-above rank 2 among all original entrants; bankrupted entrants rank below surviving entrants

reward.choice: one of three seeded common relics; inventory cap 5; no chip mint

entries.requirements: player would retain >=1 Lifechip and has available covenant slot

nodes.label: The Lantern Circuit
nodes.success: player stack >=1 and rank <=2 among original entrants

reward.choice: one seeded non-owned relic or one spell evolution token; cannot evolve unqualified spell; no chip mint

nodes.label: The Bailiff's Ledger
nodes.boss_magic: legal spellbook only, no hidden deck peeks; public tell on every cast
nodes.success: player stack >=1 AND player tied for highest positive stack among original entrants

nodes.label: A Keeper's Audit

required_choice.effect: remove 1 Resonance from a chosen owned spell with Resonance >0; if none, use public_record

nodes.return: next main route node; never replay the failed table

nodes.label: The Ledger Opens
nodes.result: act_one_cleared; unlock next act placeholder; keep survivor chips

nodes.label: Exiled from the Circuit
nodes.result: act_one_failed_alive; character survives with existing chips; no artificial chip loss

nodes.label: Last Claim
nodes.result: run P3 claim resolver; if rescued enter fallen_registry else death

graph_notes: Start -> contract_1 -> shop -> [optional_event or skip] -> contract_2 -> boss. Fail alive -> Keeper's Audit once then forward. Never replay exhausted contract nodes.
